key: Discrete Transfer Function with Initial States
title: Discrete Transfer Fcn (with initial states)
text: 指定传递函数的初始状态；按 {External reset} 指定External state reset；{Numerator Source} 指定 Source of numerator、{Numerator Value} 指定 Numerator coefficients、{Denominator Source} 指定 Source of denominator、{Denominator Value} 指定 Denominator coefficients、{Initial states Source} 指定 Source of initial、{Initial states Value} 指定 Initial filter states、{Input processing} 指定 Sample- or frame-based processing Elements、{Optimize by skipping divide by leading denominator coefficient (a0)} 指定 Skip divide by a0、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定 Interval between samples、{View Filter Response}、{State}、{Numerator coefficients} 指定 Numerator coefficient data type、{Numerator coefficient minimum} 指定 Minimum value of numerator coefficients、{Numerator coefficient maximum} 指定 Maximum value of numerator coefficients、{Numerator product output}、{Numerator accumulator}、{Denominator coefficients} 指定 Denominator coefficient data type、{Denominator coefficient minimum} 指定 Minimum value of denominator coefficients、{Denominator coefficient maximum} 指定 Maximum value of denominator coefficients、{Denominator product output}、{Denominator accumulator}、{Output}、{Output minimum} 指定 Minimum value of output、{Output maximum} 指定 Maximum value of output、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 指定 Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data、{Integer rounding mode} 指定 Rounding mode for fixed-point operations、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定 Method of overflow action、{State name} 指定 Unique name for block、{State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} 指定 Require state name resolve to a signal，按实例取值。
